title.value: Australian Residential Aged Care Service Identifier

responsible.value: Australian Department of Health, Disability and Ageing

description.value: An Australian Residential Aged Care Service (RACS) identifier, also referred to as a residential aged care facility service identifier (RACF ID), is assigned by the Australian Department of Health, Disability and Ageing to a subsidised residential aged care service. Changes to this naming system are managed by the Australian HL7 Affiliate (HL7 Australia).

usage.value: Residential Aged Care Service patient identification.

comment.value: This value is used for Australian FHIR Implementations.
This value is used in Australian CDA documents and OID based systems.
